title: Finite-dimensional linear equivalences are homeomorphisms
statement: Let $F$ be a complete nontrivially normed field. Let $V$ and $W$ be Hausdorff topological $F$-vector spaces: addition and scalar multiplication are continuous. Suppose $V$ is finite-dimensional over $F$ [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace] (it has a finite basis). Every $F$-linear equivalence $e:V\xrightarrow{\sim}W$ is a continuous linear equivalence, meaning that its underlying bijection and its inverse are continuous.
